description: AI agent Lightning payments: L402, invoices, wallets, API discovery, budgets, self-serve signup.
name: io.github.refined-element/lightning-enable-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Strike API key for Lightning payments (recommended wallet)
environmentVariables.name: STRIKE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Nostr Wallet Connect URI (for NWC wallets like CoinOS, CLINK, Alby Hub)
environmentVariables.name: NWC_CONNECTION_STRING

environmentVariables.description: LND admin macaroon in hex format
environmentVariables.name: LND_MACAROON_HEX

environmentVariables.description: OpenNode API key (direct payments only, no L402 support)
environmentVariables.name: OPENNODE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Lightning Enable API key (unlocks producer + ASA tools). Optional: no key? The create_lightning_enable_account tool self-provisions one for ~100 sats over Lightning — no card, no subscription required.
environmentVariables.name: LIGHTNING_ENABLE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Nostr relay URL for agent events (default: wss://agents.lightningenable.com)
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_RELAY_URL

title: Lightning Enable MCP Server
